body: In my case this behavior is caused by `Target::getMessagePrefix()`, which access `user` component, which starts `session`, which logs `Session::open()` and thus invokes `Logger::flush()` before its previous run is complete.

Following check in `Target` fails:

```
$user = Yii::$app->has('user', true) ? Yii::$app->get('user') : null;
```

This happens, because controller has an `AccessControl` filter attached, which always load `user` component but not starts session.

Actually there is a call

```
$user->getId(false);
```

while `User::getId()` does NOT actually have any parameters.
I assume it should accept boolean value `$autoRenew`, which should be passed to `getIdentidy()` method preventing session to be strarted.
@klimov-paul Thanks for finding this out. I just checked in a fix.
